How to play

Two buns. Stack every word that fits between them.

Mind the buns Every word must start with the top letter and end with the bottom letter.
Three letters or more Tap the built-in keys to build a word, then hit GO. It has to be a real word in the dictionary.
Longer stacks score bigger The longer and rarer the word, the more points and the fancier the ingredient.
Ingredient guide
3–4 lettersLettuce
5–6 lettersTomato
7–8 lettersCheese
9+ lettersPatty

Pass and play

Last one standing wins. Find one word before your clock runs out, then pass the phone on. Seconds you don't use carry over to your next turn. Letters start easy and get tougher every round.
